scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w client run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w client run build && npm -w server run build
scripts.test: npm -w server run test && npm -w client run test
scripts.typecheck: npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w client run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
